name: customers-across-result-pages
description: The Mule netsuite:query operation returns every matching record (the connector pages internally), so a result spanning two NetSuite pages renders all rows, in order. The page is matched in document order; only whitespace between tags is free. bodies/customers-two-pages.html is the readable form.

source.reference: get-customer-list-from-netsuite/src/main/app/get-customer-list-from-netsuite.xml (netsuite:query feeds the whole result to the DataWeave 'payload map'); get-customer-list-from-netsuite/README.md (lists all customers whose last name starts with the parameter)

body.q: SELECT email,firstName,lastName FROM CUSTOMER WHERE lastName like 'A%' ORDER BY lastName ASC
SELECT email,firstName,lastName FROM CUSTOMER WHERE lastName like 'A%' ORDER BY lastName ASC
